lines.en: I walk forward with my gun up
My boots come down hard
My helmet sits a little crooked
I advance one step at a time
I move between craters

lines.zh: 我的制服破烂，扣子还在
lines.en: My uniform is torn, but the buttons hold
I stop and raise a hand to check my heading
I go around the fire
I walk straight, as if on parade
My rifle always points ahead
I kick bones out of the way
I'm counting something under my breath
I hold the gun up without moving
I reload, very slowly
My goggles reflect the firelight

lines.zh: 我低头看了一眼胸前的牌
lines.en: I glance at the tag on my chest
I don't need to breathe anymore
I work the bolt

lines.zh: 我数着弹匣里剩下的子弹。
lines.en: I count the rounds left in my magazine.
My finger stays on the trigger
I'm quiet, quieter than the living
I remember a little of the drill
I raise the muzzle
You're not in uniform
I look at you for two seconds
You carry no identification
I once stood like that

lines.zh: 我的头盔下面没有表情
lines.en: There's no expression under my helmet
Don't reach out suddenly
My muzzle tracks you
You've backed to a safe distance
I like it when you talk

lines.zh: 我退了半步，枪口还抬着
lines.en: I step back, muzzle still up
I look down and check my gear
I make no sound at all
I draw myself up again

lines.zh: 我的制服又多了一个洞
lines.en: Another hole in my uniform
I bring the rifle up
I lean behind cover
I'm still on the roster
I tug the sling
I shift forward half a boot
Bullets; pass me some
My magazine is empty
Set the ammunition down

lines.zh: 我闻不到，可我知道它在
lines.en: I can't smell it, but I know it's there

lines.zh: 我的食指一抽，扣上扳机
lines.en: My finger twitches onto the trigger
Two rounds would do
That's the wrong caliber
I reach out; don't back away
Good, resupply is here
I still remember how to load
You hit me and I'm hard
The shove turns me a step

lines.zh: 我的枪撞了一下你的护甲
lines.en: My rifle knocks your armor

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，我站住了
lines.en: We collide and I hold my ground
You brush past my shoulder
I take it on the rifle

lines.zh: 这一下把我撞退了半步
lines.en: That knocks me back half a step
I re-level the muzzle
You mean no harm, right
I've made half a step of room
There are more uniforms up ahead
We stand shoulder to shoulder
It doesn't look back at me
We raise our rifles together
Its uniform is more intact than mine
We head the same way
It gives me half a magazine
Neither of us says a word
We hold this position
The line holds, so do we
I crouch and pick it up

lines.zh: 我枪里的子弹，是捡来的。
lines.en: The bullets in my gun were scavenged.
I can still use this
This thing is rusted through
I put it in my chest pocket
The serial number's still there
I'll bring it back and report
This must be turned in
I tuck it into my belt
Don't touch it; it's ordnance
Target ahead
I bring my rifle up
I counted three seconds
You have no clearance
No one should be in this sector
My muzzle is already on you
I'm chambered

lines.zh: 我不需要给我一个理由
lines.en: I don't need a reason given
Halt; do not move
I begin to push forward
My breathing hasn't changed
The rules of the field are simple
I'll give you exactly one chance

lines.zh: 准星压在你的胸口，别动。
lines.en: My sights rest on your chest; do not move.
My finger is half into the trigger
I walk and aim
Gunfire draws more of them
I wait for you to show yourself
I advance a step and hold
I know you've moved
I shift to this side of cover
Half a magazine left
I lower the muzzle a little
I don't waste rounds
This whole sector is in my field of fire
You're counting my shots
I've been counting your steps
You didn't see me chamber it
I work along the foot of the wall
I wait for you to break
This shot will land
I've changed position
The line still needs me
Don't try my flank
One more step will do
I fire and the muzzle flash lights my face

lines.zh: 枪管顶住你的护甲，我扣扳机。
lines.en: I press the barrel to your armor and pull the trigger.

lines.zh: 这一枪打在你的护甲上
lines.en: The round lands on your armor
I press in and pull the trigger
The impact shoves you back a step

lines.zh: 弹壳落在地上，响了一下
lines.en: A casing hits the ground and rings

lines.zh: 你侧身躲开，我的枪打空了
lines.en: You twist aside and I miss

lines.zh: 我攥住你的领口往上提
lines.en: I haul you up by the collar
That one came with a knee
I chamber another round

lines.zh: 你挡住了枪，可手臂发麻
lines.en: You block the rifle and your arm goes numb
I press you shot by shot
My rifle jams
I don't run; I stand and shoot
I step back and fire again
I fire from point blank

lines.zh: 我用枪管拨开你的武器
lines.en: I sweep your weapon aside with the barrel

lines.zh: 这一枪贴着你的肩过去
lines.en: This round grazes your shoulder
A figure stands by the fire
I raise my rifle before I raise my head
One corner of my uniform is burned
A soldier climbs out of a crater

lines.zh: 我不记得自己死了多久
lines.en: I don't remember how long I've been dead

lines.zh: 我的脚步声和活人不一样
lines.en: My footsteps aren't a living man's
I straighten my helmet
Someone must hold the line
I check my weapon

lines.zh: 我沿着最直的线走过来
lines.en: I come along the straightest line

lines.zh: 我从弹坑边缘翻身起来
lines.en: I roll up over the crater's rim
My rifle is still warm
Someone has crossed the wire
I walk out of the smoke, step by step

lines.zh: 我被点着了，火顺着制服爬
lines.en: I catch fire and it climbs my uniform

lines.zh: 我从高处摔下，头重重一磕
lines.en: I fall from a height and my head cracks down

lines.zh: 水灌进肺里，我不需要它了
lines.en: Water floods my lungs; I don't need them
The blast throws me into a crater
The shot pierces my shoulder patch

lines.zh: 那股力量让我的手指僵住
lines.en: That force locks my fingers

lines.zh: 我已经很久没领补给了
lines.en: I haven't drawn rations in a long while

lines.zh: 雷击把枪从我手里打掉
lines.en: Lightning knocks the rifle from my hands
No position below
